is one step of the seminar. It ends with a **Do it** task and one set of
questions. The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary comparison-criteria system-requirements graphics-settings bottleneck decision-matrix porting certification cross-save >}}

## 24.1 Criteria for the comparison

- **Reach**, **fit for the game**, **cost and time**, **performance**,
  **testing**, **business model**.
- Facts from **reliable sources** with a date.

![Criteria for comparing platforms.](images/criteria.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Write the criteria and weights first, then score.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your criteria"}
Choose a game you know; write five criteria for its next platform, with a
reason each.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Criteria"}
Choose the criterion.

::: {.match extra="the logo colour|the font"}
"Console players spend the most."
:   business model

"We already use the engine, PC is easy."
:   cost and time

"Our players race on the bus."
:   fit for the game

"Thousands of PC configurations to check."
:   testing
:::
:::

## 24.2 Specifications and performance

- GPU, CPU and memory decide the frame rate; the weakest part is the
  **bottleneck**.
- Too little memory: the game stutters.
- Targets per platform; **graphics settings**; **minimum** and
  **recommended** requirements.

![Targets per platform (example values).](images/targets.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/spec-check.html" poster="sims/spec-check.png" title="Spec Check: will Pocket Quest run well?" height="700" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Test the minimum on the weakest supported device, not on the developers'
PCs.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Find the settings"}
In **Spec Check**, find the highest setting with 60 fps for each device;
write the minimum and recommended requirements.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Specs"}
Use Spec Check. Choose the right answer (example points).

::: {.match extra="ultra|4K"}
the best 60 fps setting on the old laptop
:   low

the frame rate of the office PC on high
:   40 fps

the bottleneck of the office PC on high
:   the GPU

the device that runs ultra at 60 fps or more
:   the gaming PC
:::
:::

## 24.3 The decision matrix

- Criteria with **weights**; scores 1 to 5 with reasons.
- Total = Σ score × weight; the highest wins **for these weights**.
- A **sensitivity check:** change a weight, does the winner change?

![A decision matrix (example scores).](images/decision-matrix.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/decision-matrix.html" poster="sims/decision-matrix.png" title="Decision Matrix: the next platform for Pocket Quest" height="620" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A few points apart is close: say which weight decides.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your matrix"}
In **Decision Matrix**, find weights where the console wins with reach at 2
or more. Then make your own matrix with three platforms.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · The matrix"}
Use Decision Matrix. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="50|12"}
PC with the Byte Bay weights (3, 3, 2, 1, 1)
:   37

console with the Byte Bay weights
:   35

the winner with equal weights
:   the console

PC with cost and time at 3
:   41
:::
:::

## 24.4 From the matrix to a recommendation

- The question, the matrix, the choice with its margin, the **port plan**,
  the risks.
- Port plan: controls, menus, settings, accounts and saves, store rules,
  testing.

![What changes in a port?](images/port-checklist.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
List the porting work before the decision, not after.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your recommendation"}
Write a one-page recommendation: question, matrix, choice with margin, a
five-point port plan, one risk.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · The port plan"}
Choose the point of the port plan.

::: {.match extra="a new logo|a longer trailer"}
touch steering becomes keys and sticks
:   controls

low, medium, high and ultra
:   graphics settings

level 12 on the phone and on the PC
:   accounts and saves

the console maker checks the build
:   store rules (certification)
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Port Planner {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six test reports: **20 fps** on an old laptop, **"Tap to start"** on the
console, an **unplugged controller**, a store page **without
requirements**, **level 1** on the PC, and a **late car** at 70 ms ping.

{{< sim file="sims/port-planner.html" poster="sims/port-planner.png" title="Port Planner: fix the test reports" kind="game" height="480" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The reports"}
Choose the best fix.

::: {.match extra="a lower price|more race tracks"}
20 fps on an old laptop
:   low, medium and high settings

freeze when the controller is unplugged
:   pause, show a message, resubmit

no hardware facts on the store page
:   minimum and recommended requirements

the car reacts late at 70 ms ping
:   a server region near the players
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Compare platforms with criteria and weights written first.
- Specs decide the frame rate; the weakest part is the bottleneck.
- Settings and requirements let many devices run the game.
- A decision matrix gives totals for given weights; check the
  sensitivity.
- A recommendation needs the choice, the margin, a port plan and the
  risks.
